rules.message: No AI attribution in commits or PRs: drop the Co-Authored-By, "Generated with Claude Code" and session-link lines.
Make the branch with `git branch <name> <start>` and then `git checkout <name>`: checkout -b with a start point once set an upstream that pushed to development.
Commits and pushes need a clear yes from the user.
Name the owner explicitly: aidan-nunn-sys/<repo> for anything personal (~/Work/personal), awnunn_ncstate/<repo> only for school (~/Work/school). gh's default account is the school one.
rules.why: User: personal repos must be under aidan-nunn-sys, not the school account; one got created under awnunn_ncstate by default.
